6.406 rsScopeReferenceInComplexExpression
Applies to RDL 2012/01
rsScopeReferenceInComplexExpression is a critical error that occurs when a reference to a Scope in a
Global.Scopes collection is used in a complex expression. Scope references can be used only in
expressions that have the form Scopes!ScopeName.Fields!FieldName.Value.
